_comment: Bank of short pathology descriptions (CONCH caption style). encode_text_bank.py encodes each sentence; the top-r left singular vectors of the embeddings give the text subspace B of ConceptTail MIL. Broad on purpose: lymph node, breast, other organs, cell types, architecture, stains and artifacts.
